oak: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE harvestable tree sprite for an existing 2D medieval Nordic snowy village game. References1 and2 are the EXISTING SPRUCE and BIRCH that must be matched exactly in drawing language: soft warm-grey/brown contour, broad matte colour masses, very little grain, simple 2-3 value anime-game brush shading, muted grey-green and grey-brown materials, pale white snow and soft blue-grey snow shadows. One FULL tree with generous 8% transparent margin on every side, root at bottom center, no ground disk. Orthographic slightly top-down game view: visible upper surfaces of branches, no horizon. True transparent background. No text, border, labels, black heavy outline, pixels, photoreal bark, glossy plastic, sparks, glow, tiny background trees. Thin broken natural snow strips on upper branch surfaces, NEVER rounded snow pillows. Never bonsai, niwaki, topiary, cloud-pruned pads or ornamental eastern garden silhouettes. Subject: old sturdy leafless winter OAK. A thick grey-brown trunk with a broad base, splitting into several stout upward-reaching limbs and many irregular finer bare twigs. Broad rounded but OPEN natural branching silhouette. No foliage (hard winter), no autumn leaves. The tree is about1.35 times as tall as its maximum branch width, a substantial full-grown forest oak. Branching begins at about the lower third of height; recognizable oak zigzag branches, different from slender silver birch. Snow sits sparingly along thick horizontal/upward limbs. A slightly weathered but straight main trunk, no S curve, no sculpted decorative bends. Entire full silhouette including twigs and roots, all inside safe margins.
